name: dyngen
simulation_summary: Simulates dynamic single-cell gene regulatory processes from a user-specified backbone, exposing cell-state annotations, regulatory ground truth and optional multimodal trajectory-derived artefacts such as RNA velocity and cell-specific GRNs.

artifacts_aux.description: Directed milestone-state network describing the simulated trajectory topology.
Per-cell soft assignments over milestone states derived from the simulated trajectory.
Per-cell progression records along directed milestone transitions.
Ground-truth RNA velocity vectors derived from the simulated reactions.
Cell-specific regulatory interaction scores that can be aggregated into state- or group-level truth.

scrna_global.notes: Global scRNA snapshots can be generated from either built-in dyngen backbones or a custom backbone definition without exporting explicit groups.

scrna_grouped.notes: Groups can be derived from milestone assignments, lineage_tree from the milestone network, and group-level truth from cell-specific regulatory activity.

backbone_template.description: Built-in dyngen backbone constructor used to define the simulated trajectory topology.

num_cells.description: Number of cells to sample from the simulated process.

num_tfs.description: Number of transcription factors. When null, dyngen uses the number of modules in the selected backbone.

num_targets.description: Number of target genes downstream of the transcription-factor network.

num_hks.description: Number of housekeeping genes to include in the simulation.

distance_metric.description: Distance metric used internally by dyngen for cell-to-cell distance calculations.

tf_network_params.description: Serializable subset of dyngen TF-network generation parameters.

min_tfs_per_module.description: Minimum number of TFs generated per module.

weighted_sampling.description: Whether regulator sampling should be weighted by current target counts.

realnet.description: Optional dyngen realnet identifier. When null, dyngen samples one from its bundled collection.

damping.description: Damping factor used in the PageRank-based target sampling step.

target_resampling.description: Optional finite resampling cap for targets. When null, dyngen uses its unbounded default.

max_in_degree.description: Maximum in-degree permitted in the sampled feature network.

tau.description: Tau used by dyngen when simulating the regulatory gold standard.

simulate_targets.description: Whether to include target genes when simulating the gold standard, not only TF molecules.

burn_time.description: Optional explicit burn-in time. When null, dyngen derives it from the backbone.

total_time.description: Optional explicit total simulation time. When null, dyngen derives it from the backbone.

ssa_etl_tau.description: Tau parameter for dyngen's ssa_etl stochastic simulation algorithm.

num_simulations.description: Number of wild-type simulations used to sample cells.

num_knockdown_simulations.description: Number of knockdown simulations to include in addition to wild-type simulations.

store_reaction_firings.description: Whether to store reaction firing logs in the dyngen dataset object.

store_reaction_propensities.description: Whether to store reaction propensities in the dyngen dataset object.

compute_dimred.description: Whether dyngen should compute dimension reductions in the wrapped dataset.

compute_rna_velocity.description: Whether to simulate spliced and unspliced abundances allowing RNA velocity ground truth.

kinetics_noise_kind.description: Kinetics noise preset passed to dyngen.

kinetics_noise_mean.description: Mean for dyngen's simple kinetics noise preset.

kinetics_noise_sd.description: Standard deviation for dyngen's simple kinetics noise preset.

kind.description: Whether dyngen should sample a snapshot experiment or a synchronised time-course experiment.

map_reference_cpm.description: Whether to map to the reference CPM distribution.

map_reference_ls.description: Whether to map to the reference library-size distribution.

weight_bw.description: Bandwidth weight used by dyngen's snapshot experiment sampler.

num_timepoints.description: Number of timepoints used by dyngen's synchronised experiment sampler.

pct_between.description: Fraction of synchronised cells sampled between timepoints.
